sierra-leone.title: Flag of the Republic of Sierra Leone

colors.note: Represents agriculture, the mountains, and natural resources.
Represents the natural harbour of Freetown and the Atlantic Ocean.

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of green, white, and blue
- The colours reflect Sierra Leone's landscape, principles, and coastal geography
- Adopted on 27 April 1961 upon independence from the United Kingdom
trivia:
- The flag was designed by the College of Arms in London ahead of independence
- Blue refers specifically to the natural harbour of Freetown, one of the largest in the world
- Sierra Leone has kept the same flag through decades of political upheaval and civil war
- The tricolour is frequently displayed vertically at ceremonies in the capital
